name: 1Password
description: Your 1Password logins as a column. ↵ pastes the password, ⇧↵ the username, and a second column pastes one-time codes. Uses op through the 1Password app; secrets are never stored or shown.

setup: Open 1Password and turn on “Integrate with 1Password CLI” in Settings › Developer. On macOS 27, also allow yabbistir under Privacy & Security › Files & Folders.
locked: 1Password is locked or didn’t allow access. Unlock it and approve its prompt, then open this column again.
lockedRun: 1Password is locked or didn’t allow access. Unlock it and approve its prompt, then try again.
noAnswer: 1Password didn’t answer in time. Approve its prompt if it shows one, then open this column again.
noAnswerRun: 1Password didn’t answer in time. Approve its prompt if it shows one, then try again.
slowList: 1Password took too long to list your logins. Choose one vault in Settings to list fewer.
offline: 1Password couldn’t reach its server. Check your internet connection, then open this column again.
offlineRun: 1Password couldn’t reach its server. Check your internet connection, then try again.
updateNeededRun: op needs an update: brew upgrade 1password-cli
badAccount: The account in Settings should be a sign-in address, such as my.1password.com, or an ID.
unknownAccount: 1Password has no account “{account}”. Check the account in Settings.
badVault: The vault in Settings should be one vault’s name or ID, on one line.
unknownVault: 1Password has no vault “{vault}”. Check the vault in Settings.
listFailed: op could not list your logins.
readFailed: op could not read this item.
noCode: This item has no one-time code.
